title: San Francisco public housing audits found rent mismatches and missing safety records

beats.text: An active San Francisco public housing record still included someone who had left.

visual.sub: A former participant remained on the active public housing list

beats.text: The person had left in August 2015.

visual.kicker: A former participant remained on the active public housing list

beats.text: The audit did not identify a payment to that person.
Later, three rent amounts disagreed with the federal form.

visual.kicker: Rent amounts disagreed across records and testing records were missing

beats.text: For 23 of 60 participants tested in 2020, environmental documentation was missing.
Missing records do not establish that residents were exposed to a hazard.

visual.kicker: Rent amounts disagreed across records and testing records were missing

beats.text: In 2021 the auditors lacked eligibility documentation for 25 of 60 participants.

visual.kicker: The next two audits still found missing tenant documentation

beats.text: The next year, twelve of 59 files lacked that supporting material.
The Authority then converted its remaining public housing properties.

visual.kicker: The program had no tenants in the following audit year

beats.text: The 2023 follow-up said this program had no tenants.

visual.kicker: The program had no tenants in the following audit year

beats.text: That left the earlier documentation gaps unresolved at the individual level.
Every source is linked in the case file below.
